defect: a changing register value is transferred as independently synchronized bus bits without an atomic update boundary
rationale: data_a can change as a word in clk_a while each bit is sampled independently in clk_b, so data_b can combine values from different source updates.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: The 4-bit data is synchronised bit by bit with no handshake, so the destination can see a mix of old and new bits.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the source/destination register CDC context and reduced the arbitration protocol to four destination bit pipelines in a self-contained top module.

mutation.description: Sampled each data_a bit through an independent pair of destination registers and assembled data_b without an atomic handshake.
